adjudication.rationale: The diff shows three separate “fetch credential from DB” implementations that already diverge. In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` (both in `createAllCalendarEvents` and in the calendar reference update loop), `prisma.credential.findUnique` includes `app: { select: { slug: true } }` and then manually maps to a `CredentialWithAppName` object using `credentialFromDB.app.slug`. In `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts` (around the new loop over `bookingCalendarReference`), the fallback fetch is `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: credentialId } })` with no `app` include/mapping. This is a concrete maintainability/consistency issue introduced by the diff (duplicate logic already diverging), though it’s not verifiably a functional bug from the diff alone.
